product_metadata.title: WELTRXE Pebbles Bath Mat Clear Non-Slip Bathtub Mat with Suction Cups, Drain Holes for Bathroom Showers, Tub, Machine Washable, BPA, Latex Free Safe Shower Mats, Oval 27 x 14 Inch
features: ♦ UNIQUE PEBBLE DESIGN: It has alternating rough and smooth textures that soothes your feet with a sumptuous touch, and the spaces between pebbles makes for easy water drainage. While the fresh, clean palette perfectly complements any bathroom décor.

♦ NON-SLIP OVAL BATH MAT: 27 x 14in. Our bathtub mat features 167 strong suction cups that attach securely on smooth, clean surfaces, won't slip on the bath or shower floor. It’s also heavier and thicker than other mats. Great for home, spa, gym bath and shower.

♦ DURABLE & SAFE BATHROOM MAT: This non-slip bath mat with suction cups is made of durable vinyl to provide reliable non slip resistance. Eco-friendly, BPA Free, Latex Free and Phthalate free to make this bath mat perfect for your needs.

♦ MACHINE WASHABLE: The tub mat is machine washable for hassle-free maintenance. Simply wash it with machine wash cold, gentle detergent (no bleach) and air dry. We recommend rinsing and drying your bath mat periodically to remove oily and slippery buildup that may occur over time.

♦ CAUTION: Clean surface before using. Place Secure suction cups before each use. Bathroom mat will only attach to clean, smooth surface. Not for use on textured, tiled, or non-smooth surfaces. Do not use bath oils - may cause slipping.
